summary: Bradbury Capital Inc., a Malaysian-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly TETE Technologies), filed a 6-K disclosing a Warrant Adjustment Notice to holders of 12,450,721 public warrants, effective after the October 30, 2026 close. Triggered by an $8.00 per-share PIPE tied to the October 6, 2026 de-SPAC business combination, the warrant exercise price falls from $11.50 to $9.20 (115% of the newly issued price), and the redemption trigger drops from $18.00 to $14.40. Market Value was $5.09. Watch warrant overhang and dilution dynamics.
